boilerplate.headline: ODD in one paragraph.
boilerplate.body: ODD is a Helsinki-born initiative working to strengthen creative and cultural work and bring its expertise closer to business and wider society. Its current work includes ODDfest, a city-wide creative week made by independent hosts across Helsinki; ODDference, a professional event exploring what business and society can learn from creative expertise; ODDspace, a year-round workspace and event space in Vallila; and project work with organisations. ODD is operated by New Nordic Way rf, a Finnish non-profit association based in Helsinki.

items.title: ODDfest 2026 — dates, theme and venues
items.description: ODDfest Fri–Sat, June 12–13, 2026 · ODDference Thu–Fri, June 11–12, 2026 · Creative Week Mon–Sun, June 8–14, 2026. Theme: "Bravery". Venues: Lasipalatsi, Kulttuurikasarmi, Tavastia Club, Semifinal, Kamppi Chapel, Vanha Ylioppilastalo. Programme curators: Minna Tervamäki, Suvi Honkanen, Otto Kylmälä, Pihla Viitala, Johanna Oras, Jonas Verwijnen, Ukko-Pekka Itäpelto, Emmi Kärnä, Karoliina Jarenko, Elisabet Lahti.

items.title: ODDfest 2025 Impact Report
items.description: The first ODDfest, in numbers: 2,600 attendees (1,900+ signups), 83 sessions across 8 stages, 150+ speakers and artists (20+ nationalities), 350+ contributors, €400K direct economic impact (€320K invested into the creative economy), 20+ collaborative projects sparked within two months, 1M total audience reach across 20+ countries.
